title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the local rate of entropy generation per unit volume.

title: Heat Conduction Law
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply Fourier's law of heat conduction in their solution.

title: Entropy Flow Concept
description: Important Criteria: The student must demonstrate an understanding of the concept of entropy flow in relation to heat conduction.

title: Temperature Gradient
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly identify and utilize the temperature gradient in their calculations.

title: Sign Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common sign mistakes when applying the equations related to heat flow and entropy.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all units are consistent throughout their calculations.

title: Irreversible Entropy Increase
description: Important Criteria: The student should explain the role of irreversible entropy increase due to temperature inhomogeneity.
